name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Channel Partnerships & B2B SaaS Sales Professional
summary: Channel partnerships and B2B SaaS sales professional with 15+ years across SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments — pairing quota-carrying, full-cycle sales with hands-on channel and partner management. Built and grew a high-volume partner network at Birdeye, owned full-cycle sales and C-suite SaaS negotiations at Accelo and Fivestars, and founded Solenzo, taking go-to-market and partner programs from A to Z. A self-starter and relationship-builder who moves fast, thrives in global SaaS organizations, and is based in the Denver metro for the hybrid role.

Develop and execute outbound lead-generation strategies, automating prospecting, enrichment, and appointment booking to generate qualified pipeline for service-based businesses.
Identify expansion opportunities and scope complementary, verticalized solutions aligned to client objectives, negotiating retainer scope and structuring deals.
Collaborate directly with business owners and sales teams to align programs with revenue objectives, ensuring consistent messaging and qualified lead flow.
Track performance with data-driven dashboards across pipeline progression, campaign ROI, and conversion, prioritizing the highest-value opportunities.

Built rigorous performance reporting across ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering QBRs and optimization recommendations.

Collaborated cross-functionally with Product and Engineering, channeling high-priority partner feedback to close product and service gaps.
